LESSON: CARE OF THE TEETH

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.2: Care of the teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Care of the teeth. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify milk teeth as temporary in childhood,
2. mention hygienic practices to observe during shedding of milk teeth,
3. observe hygienic practices during shedding of milk teeth,
4. appreciate shedding of teeth as a natural process. during shedding of teeth(washing hands, gurgling salty water after extraction, proper disposal of shed tooth, proper disposal of soiled materials used after tooth extraction) of hygienic practices during shedding of teeth. 140 Learners role play hygienic practices to observe during shedding of teeth

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Care of the teeth.
2. Explain Care of the teeth to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Care of the teeth.
4. Show that you can: identify milk teeth as temporary in childhood,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Care of the teeth. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Care of the teeth important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify milk teeth as temporary in childhood,
2. mention hygienic practices to observe during shedding of milk teeth,
3. observe hygienic practices during shedding of milk teeth,
4. appreciate shedding of teeth as a natural process. during shedding of teeth(washing hands, gurgling salty water after extraction, proper disposal of shed tooth, proper disposal of soiled materials used after tooth extraction) of hygienic practices during shedding of teeth. 140 Learners role play hygienic practices to observe during shedding of teeth
